summary: Ethan calls Seoyun: there's an important job at work the wedding weekend and he may not get leave; he hasn't asked yet and nobody else can do it. Seoyun reminds him Dad gave him a pepper and that he's family now, and that 준수 would be stuck next to Mom alone. They agree not to tell Mom yet; he'll call again soon. Unresolved.

paragraphs.ko: 저녁에 이선은 혼자 집에 있었다. 오래 생각하다가 서윤이에게 전화를 했다.
paragraphs.en: In the evening, Ethan was home alone. After thinking for a long while, he called Seoyun.

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: "이선아, 무슨 일 있어? 목소리가 안 좋아. 밥은 먹었어?"
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: "Ethan, is something wrong? You don't sound good. Did you eat?"

paragraphs.ko: 이선: "서윤아… 나 결혼식에 못 갈 수도 있어." 서윤: "뭐? 왜?"
paragraphs.en: Ethan: "Seoyun... I might not be able to go to the wedding." Seoyun: "What? Why?"

paragraphs.ko: 이선: "지금 일이 너무 많아. 그 주말에 중요한 일이 하나 있어. 그래서 휴가를 받지 못할 수도 있어."
paragraphs.en: Ethan: "There's way too much work right now. There's an important job that weekend. So I might not be able to get leave."

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: "휴가 이야기는 했어?" 이선: "아직 말하지 못했어. 그리고 그 일은 다른 사람이 못 해. 나만 할 수 있어."
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: "Did you bring up the leave?" Ethan: "I haven't been able to say anything yet. And nobody else can do that job. Only I can."

paragraphs.ko: 서윤이는 바로 말하지 못했다. "엄마가 많이 기다리고 있는데. 아빠도. 아빠가 너한테 고추도 줬잖아. 너 이제 우리 가족이잖아."
paragraphs.en: Seoyun couldn't answer right away. "Mom is really looking forward to it. Dad too. Dad even gave you a pepper. You're part of our family now."

paragraphs.ko: 이선: "나도 알아. 나도 정말 가고 싶어. 그래서 밤에도 계속 그 생각만 했어."
paragraphs.en: Ethan: "I know. I really want to go too. That's all I could think about, even at night."

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: "그리고 준수는? 너 없으면 혼자 엄마 옆에 앉아야 돼. 엄마 이야기 정말 길잖아." 이선: "그건 준수한테 정말 큰 문제네."
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: "And Junsu? Without you, he has to sit next to Mom alone. Mom's stories are really long, you know." Ethan: "That's a really big problem for Junsu."

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: "엄마한테는 내가 말할까?" 이선: "아니야, 아직 말하지 마. 나도 아직 잘 모르니까. 곧 다시 이야기하자."
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: "Should I tell Mom?" Ethan: "No, don't tell her yet. I don't really know yet either. Let's talk again soon."

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: "그래. 기다려 보자. 준수도 너 기다려. 그리고 이선아, 너 오면 엄마가 또 '더 먹어' 할 거야."
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: "Okay. Let's wait and see. Junsu's waiting for you too. And Ethan, if you come, Mom will say 'eat more' again."

paragraphs.ko: 이선이 조금 웃었다. "그건 너무 좋아. 꼭 가고 싶어."
paragraphs.en: Ethan laughed a little. "That I'd love. I really want to go."

paragraphs.ko: 전화가 끝나고 이선은 다시 컴퓨터 앞에 앉았다. 할 일이 아직 많았다. 그리고 그날 밤에도 이선은 잘 자지 못했다.
paragraphs.en: After the call, Ethan sat back down at his computer. There was still a lot to do. And that night, too, he couldn't sleep well.

questions.prompt_ko: 이선은 왜 결혼식에 가지 못할 수도 있어요?
questions.prompt_en: Why might Ethan not be able to go to the wedding?

questions.prompt_ko: 이선이 결혼식에 안 오면 준수는 어떻게 돼요?
questions.prompt_en: If Ethan doesn't come, what happens to Junsu?

questions.prompt_ko: "그날 밤에도 이선은 잘 자___." (= he couldn't sleep well.) 뭐가 맞아요?
questions.prompt_en: "That night, too, Ethan ___ sleep well." Which is right?
